verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the developer site's claim that `sketchtool` can "create assets with a single command" (sketch-docs-5). Developer handoff lets developers "grab the information they need" in a browser (sketch-docs-36), which hints at asset access but does not describe export itself. Missing for 10: any documentation of PNG/SVG/PDF export formats, per-layer export presets, scale options (e.g. @2x/@3x), slices, in-app export UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
